_meta.description: Knotify backend database schema for the React Native frontend. Mirrors infrastructure/db/migrations/ and db_tables_summary.txt. Use it to generate TypeScript types, form validators, and API client models. The frontend never talks to Postgres directly — it hits REST/AppSync endpoints declared in backend-config.json — but response payloads for /profile/*, /profiles/*, /match/deck etc. are shaped from these columns.
_meta.schemaChangesSince1_0_0: Migrations 0019 and 0020 land in this version but neither changes column shapes or constraints relevant to the frontend — 0019 disables Supabase-auto-enabled RLS on the six grant-based tables (siblings, friendships, friend_requests, bookmarks, blocks, refresh_log) so app_user's grants function as designed; 0020 revokes Supabase's default PostgREST grants from anon/authenticated/service_role on all public-schema tables (security hotfix — frontend never used the PostgREST surface so this is transparent). Payload shapes and field semantics are unchanged from 1.0.0.

conventions.primaryKeyType: UUID (Cognito sub for users, gen_random_uuid() elsewhere)
conventions.softDelete: users.deleted_at IS NULL means live; NOT NULL means soft-deleted
conventions.cascadeRule: All FKs to users(user_id) use ON DELETE CASCADE
conventions.textVsVarchar: All string columns are TEXT (unbounded); frontend imposes its own max lengths
conventions.booleans: Native BOOLEAN, serialized as true/false in JSON payloads
conventions.jsonb: users.preferences is JSONB — sent/received as a plain object
conventions.vector: users.preference_vector is pgvector vector(20) — backend-computed, never sent to frontend

users.description: Primary profile table. One row per Cognito user. Bootstrap row is inserted by the post-confirmation Lambda with email only; the remaining required fields are filled by the profile-completion flow (phase 6). Setting profile_complete_verified=true is gated by a 34-field CHECK constraint (see requiredForCompletion).

immutableTrigger.name: trg_users_immutable
immutableTrigger.behavior: BEFORE UPDATE trigger. Once one of the immutable-after-set fields is non-NULL, any change to a different non-NULL value raises 'Attempted to modify immutable field' (SQLSTATE P0001). NULL -> first-value transition is allowed exactly once. Soft-delete rewrite exception added in 0018.
immutableTrigger.frontendGuidance: Grey out or disable these fields in the edit-profile UI after they have been populated. Show a tooltip explaining they cannot be changed.

username.unique: case-insensitive partial (lower(username) WHERE username IS NOT NULL) — migration 0010
username.notes: Required at profile completion. Rename rate-limit (1 per 30 days) enforced in API layer, not DB.

age.notes: Read-only. Never send in PATCH payloads.

photo_url.notes: Direct URL. Phase-12 photo pipeline (S3+CloudFront) will replace this.

marriage_time.notes: Backfilled by 0012; never NULL for new rows. NOT in requiredForCompletion.

profile_complete_verified.notes: Server-controlled. Flipped to true only when all requiredForCompletion fields are non-NULL. Mirrored into Cognito JWT as the custom:profile_complete claim.

preferences.notes: Free-form object. GIN-indexed for @> containment queries. Frontend sends/receives a plain JS object.

preference_vector.notes: Backend-computed from preferences. NEVER exposed to the frontend — API responses strip this field.

checkConstraints.sex_domain: sex IS NULL OR sex IN ('Male','Female')
checkConstraints.profile_complete_requires_required_field: If profile_complete_verified=true, all 34 fields in requiredForCompletion must be NOT NULL (widened in 0012 from the original 5-field check).

indexes.idx_users_sex_country_religion: (sex, current_residence_country, religion) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
indexes.users_username_lower_unique: UNIQUE (lower(username)) WHERE username IS NOT NULL — migration 0010

siblings.description: 1-to-many with users. Free-text sibling records for the family section of the profile.

sibling_age.notes: Stored as TEXT to allow entries like 'late 20s'

friendships.description: Confirmed mutual friendships. One row per pair, canonicalized so user_a < user_b (Postgres UUID comparison). Application code MUST canonicalize before inserting: user_a=MIN(id1,id2), user_b=MAX(id1,id2).
friendships.frontendGuidance: The API exposes friends via GET /friends and DELETE /friends/{userId} — you never need to think about user_a/user_b ordering. The endpoint returns the other user's profile regardless of which side of the pair the current user is on.

friend_requests.description: In-flight friend requests with a status lifecycle: pending -> accepted | declined | cancelled.

responded_at.notes: Set when status transitions out of 'pending'

uniqueConstraints.unique_from_to_status: (from_user_id, to_user_id, status) — prevents duplicate pending requests but allows one accepted/declined/cancelled row to coexist

bookmarks.description: Users a given user has bookmarked (saved for later review). Directional: (user_id) bookmarked (bookmarked_user_id).

blocks.description: Unidirectional block relationships. Enforced bidirectionally in match/chat queries: if A blocks B, neither sees the other in deck, search, or chat.

deck_view.description: Materialized view of swipe-deck-eligible users (deleted_at IS NULL AND profile_complete_verified=true). Backing store for GET /match/deck. Refreshed CONCURRENTLY every 15 minutes by a scheduled Lambda.
deck_view.filter: deleted_at IS NULL AND profile_complete_verified = true

preference_vector.notes: Added in 0011. Backend-only — stripped from API responses.

religion.notes: Added in 0011. Used by the religion hard filter.

indexes.idx_deck_user: UNIQUE (user_id) — required for REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY

refresh.cadence: Every 15 minutes via a scheduled admin Lambda; also triggerable manually after data migrations
refresh.grants: SELECT on deck_view granted to app_user (Lambda role). EXECUTE on refresh_deck_view() NOT granted to app_user.

deck_view.frontendGuidance: You do not query this view directly. GET /match/deck returns an already-filtered, already-ranked list built from this view. The response strips preference_vector and email.

extensions.pgcrypto: gen_random_uuid() — used as DEFAULT for UUID primary keys on siblings and friend_requests
extensions.pgvector: vector(20) type + HNSW index for cosine similarity on users.preference_vector

notesForFrontend.profileCompleteFlow: profile_complete_verified is a server-controlled boolean. Once true it is mirrored into the Cognito JWT as custom:profile_complete. /match/* endpoints require it and return 403 otherwise. Route the user back to onboarding on 403 from a /match/* endpoint.
notesForFrontend.immutableFields: Grey-out first_name, last_name, sex, birthday, religion, subsect in the edit-profile UI once populated. A PATCH attempting to change them will 4xx.
notesForFrontend.usernameCasing: Username uniqueness is case-insensitive. 'Alice' and 'alice' collide. Preserve display casing on the client but treat matching as lower(username).
notesForFrontend.hiddenFields: preference_vector and internal audit columns are never included in API responses. Do not build UI around them.
notesForFrontend.softDelete: Deleted users disappear from all endpoints. If your cached list contains a user_id that no longer resolves, treat it as deleted and drop it.
notesForFrontend.deckDataFreshness: deck_view is refreshed every 15 minutes — a newly-completed profile may not appear in another user's deck for up to that window.
